content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: NIFTEM is an Institute of National Importance under Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India. The institute has opening for teaching position purely on Contract Basis for Indian Nationals. Applicants with good academic record, teaching/research experience and working in related areas of research are encouraged to apply.

rows.department: Postharvest Technology Bioprocessing and Environmental Sciences (PHTBES)

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in any of the following specializations: Life Sciences and other allied Sciences, Food Science and Technology, Agricultural Process Engineering, Basic and Applied Sciences, Agriculture Science, Bio-process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Food Biotechnology, Microbiology. In addition to the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR, ICMR, ICAR, DBT or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grands Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phill./ Ph.D. Degree) Regulations. 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be. An excellent academic record throughout, in addition to proven tract record of outstanding research ability in food sector, candidate should have published minimum 5 research papers in referred journals as per UGC guidelines with minimum cumulative impact factor of 10. As per the UGC communication dated 21st September 2016, “if the M.Phil/Ph.D. degree is awarded by a Foreign University, the Indian Institution considering such a degree shall refer the issue to a Standing Committee constituted by the concerned institution for the purpose of determining the equivalence of the degree awarded by the foreign University”.

rows.qualification: Master’s Degree with 55% Marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) from and Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University in any of the specified specializations. (One of the degree should be in above specialization at Masters/ Ph.D Level). i. Ph. D. in any of the above-mentioned subjects. ii. NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. awarded in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016. Minimum 5 research papers in referred journals as per UGC guidelines with minimum cumulative impact factor of 10.
rows.experience: Experience in any/of the above fields as evident from research work, Publications, patents etc., and having experience in Microbial Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The total emoluments for the position are Rs. 70,900/- per month (All Inclusive). The Position is purely on Contract basis initially for One Year and extendable as per requirement of the Institute.
